itemUsage.en: A trio of Felynes willing to brave death to satiate their curiosity for the world of Terra.
itemUsage.zh: 三只艾露猫，对泰拉大地充满好奇。

itemDesc.en: This may not necessarily earn you victory, but it will get you back to camp safely.
itemDesc.zh: 虽然不一定能帮助你赢得胜利，但一定能把你安全送回营地。

description.en: Attacks detonate after a delay, with one of the following random effects: Deals 200% Physical Damage / Puts the target to <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> for 1 second / <$ba.stun>Stuns</> the target for 0.1 seconds / Nothing happens at all! Talent deactivates after triggering Damage effect 3 times
description.zh: 攻击后会延时引爆，随机触发下列效果之一： 造成200%的物理伤害；目标<$ba.sleep>沉睡</>1秒；目标<$ba.stun>晕眩</>0.1秒；什么都没有发生！触发3次伤害效果后天赋失效
